title: Style, Unlocked
headline: STYLE, UNLOCKED
synopsis: Comics break out of the same 2x2 grid: free formats, 18 art styles, and lettering drawn into the art. Glitch's furry plan gets denied.
altText: A black-and-white manga page with red accents. Panel 1: a weary artist stamps identical four-panel grids on a conveyor belt. Panel 2: a young artist fans out style cards labeled NOIR, PIXEL and MANGA. Panel 3: Glitch the beetle tries to stick fox ears on a manga hero; a red stamp reads DENIED. Inset: a phone shows the finished comic.
layout: three numbered panels of different sizes like a manga page (a wide panel on top, two below), plus a small inset in the bottom-right corner that breaks the panel border

panels.scene: A weary comic artist in a hoodie stamps identical four-panel grids onto pages on an endless conveyor belt
A young artist with fierce eyes fans out a hand of glowing style cards like a card battle

dialogue.speaker: caption
dialogue.text: Now: pick a format, pick a style.

panels.scene: Glitch, a tiny red beetle, sneaks up to stick fake fox ears on a manga hero; a huge red rubber stamp slams down beside him
Small inset: a hand holds a phone showing a finished comic page
